source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: When a train or railroad vehicle is approaching the crossing, you must stop behind the stop line or before the intersection is clear.
corrections.note: Added the omitted alternative stopping location before the intersection is clear.

corrections.corrected_statement: For the first move of a three point turn, activate the left turn signal and check traffic and blind spots over your left shoulder, and when traffic is clear turn hard left to the other side of the road and stop after reaching the other side.
corrections.note: Fixed the condition so clear traffic permits the turn and stopping happens after reaching the other side.
